subject: Retroactive Consumption reconciliation & one-off settlement for HelixHealth
messages:
From: Sally Ramos <sally.ramos@helixhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected September spike — need reconciliation

Hi Marcus,

We noticed a ~3.6x spike in inference consumption for our staging cluster during Sept 12–18. Our billing portal shows a large retroactive charge posted to our account (invoice pending). Before we escalate to our finance team, can you help recon with a breakdown and propose an amnesty/one-off settlement?

Attached is a quick export from our side (attached CSV) and the support ticket reference from our ops team. We suspect an accidental test job, but we need Redwood to confirm origin and whether any credits or offsets are available.

Key asks:
- Can you confirm the root cause and which model/pool consumed the tokens?
- Suggested settlement amount or credit (we prefer a capped one-time adjustment)
- Timeline for a corrected invoice / billing hold while we agree terms

Thanks — appreciate a fast turnaround.

—Sally
Sally Ramos
Head of Cloud Ops, HelixHealth
Sally.Ramos@helixhealth.com

Attachments: usage_report_sep2026.csv, support_ticket_2345.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sally Ramos <sally.ramos@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 12:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected September spike — need reconciliation

Hi Sally — thanks for flagging and for the CSV. I’ve pulled the logs and initial pass shows a burst originating from a scheduled E2E test job that was misrouted to your dedicated pool (policy mis-tagging).

Quick summary:
- Window: 2026-09-12 02:00 UTC — 2026-09-18 18:00 UTC
- Model variant: redwood-3b-quant (dedicated pool id: dp-42)
- Estimated additional tokens: ~28M (approx $8.5k at current unit rates)
- Cause: orchestration rule incorrectly matched a global test tag (we have the routing logs)

Proposal to avoid escalation:
1) Redwood will cover 60% of the overage as a one-time customer goodwill credit ($5,100).
2) HelixHealth pays the remaining 40% ($3,400) as a one-time settlement.
3) We hold the invoice for 10 business days while legal/finance sign off. If you prefer, we can also do a roll-forward credit instead of cash refund for your next renewal quarter.

I’m looping in Lauren from finance and Grace from Customer Success to finalize exact invoice language and DocuSign. Please let me know if Helix wants a formal technical breakdown (we can attach the per-minute ingestion traces).

Best,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected September spike — need reconciliation

Hi Sally — thanks for working through this with Marcus. From a billing perspective we can do the settlement as Marcus proposed. A few implementation notes and items I need from you to issue corrected paperwork:

1) Confirmation of payment method for the $3,400 one-time settlement (PO, card, or ACH). If you want to net against your upcoming renewal we can apply as a credit; otherwise we’ll issue a corrected invoice.
2) Please confirm acceptance of Redwood covering 60% as a customer goodwill credit ($5,100) — I’ll prepare the credit memo.
3) Full legal signatory name and email for the DocuSign (we’ll send a short settlement addendum).

I’ve prepared a short settlement addendum and attached a proposed invoice/credit memo to this thread. Once we have sign-off we’ll place a billing hold and reissue the invoice as agreed.

Finance attachments: docusign_settlement_hlx.pdf (proposal), settlement_invoice_draft_2026-09.pdf

If Helix would like a deeper technical appendix, Grace can coordinate a brief trace session with our infra team.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
